page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1 thread per core, providing 4 vCPUs. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA P4 graphics processing unit with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The network configuration provides a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers entry-level GPU acceleration combined with dedicated CPU resources. The lack of local storage requires users to factor in the cost and performance of external block storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention, though the network baseline of 2 Gbps may limit high-throughput data transfer workloads.

The ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is designed for workloads that require moderate GPU acceleration and dedicated CPU compute. Suitable applications include small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, entry-level CUDA-based processing, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from a dedicated GPU.
